summary: Validated the calendar/toggle + schedule color feature on /schedules and the Riwayat Preventif additions on /reports. Backend: 10/10 pytest tests pass (POST/PUT /api/schedules persist color, default color #0284C7 when omitted, update changes color, user 403 on POST/PUT/DELETE, GET /api/reports/summary returns preventive{total_checksheets,total_schedules,with_issues,total_items,total_ok,total_not_ok} and preventive_history entries carrying ok/not_ok/operator_name/technician_name/note, user still has cost stripped). Frontend admin: default view=calendar, Kalender/Tabel toggle works and persists in sessionStorage ('table'/'calendar'), prev/next/today navigation updates calendar-month-label correctly, clicking empty day opens Tambah Jadwal with due_date prefilled, color picker swatches select (color-E11D48 persisted bg rgb(225,29,72)), new event appears on correct day with chosen color, edit via detail-edit-button updates color (color-059669 -> rgb(5,150,105)), delete via detail-delete-button + alert confirm removes event from calendar. Reports: preventive-chart-card + preventive-summary-card visible, stat-total-checksheets shows '1 dari 1 jadwal', Ekspor PDF triggers a jsPDF download (Laporan-Servis-*.pdf) without errors. Frontend operator: no Tambah Jadwal button, clicking empty day does NOT open form, event detail dialog is view-only (no edit/delete, Tutup present), preventive chart+summary visible on /reports.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py now ~970 lines - continues to exceed 700-line guideline; split schedules/reports/files into separate routers.
ScheduleIn.color has no validation (accepts any string). Consider a Pydantic validator to enforce #RRGGBB format.

ScheduleCalendar.isOverdue() parses s.due_date with new Date() which treats 'YYYY-MM-DD' as UTC; local-TZ users near UTC boundary could see off-by-one overdue markers. Low-impact in Indonesia (UTC+7) but worth normalizing with the ymd() helper already in the file.
The '+N lainnya' popup uses a custom fixed overlay (not shadcn Dialog) - a11y not ideal; works functionally.
seed_data_creation: Created and then deleted one TEST_CAL_Preventif schedule via the UI; backend test creates two schedules with cleanup DELETE at end. No residual test data.
